nodes.title: Help a user orient inside one workspace
nodes.body: A Brunch session should make the selected workspace and spec legible before asking the user to commit new graph truth.

nodes.title: A workspace may hold multiple specs
nodes.body: Each spec has separate graph truth and sessions under the same local workspace.

nodes.title: Selected spec
nodes.body: The product-facing target of the current session.

detail.definition: The one spec whose graph and sessions a current interaction targets.

nodes.title: Orientation must include only the selected spec
nodes.body: Every orientation summary must exclude facts from sibling specs unless the user explicitly switches to or compares another spec.

nodes.title: Orientation must combine every workspace spec
nodes.body: Every orientation summary must include facts from all specs in the workspace, even when the user selected only one spec and did not request a comparison.

nodes.title: Show the selected spec identity on session entry
nodes.body: The session must name the selected spec before offering the next move.
